feeds.title: La Jolla Mom Blog
feeds.description: I'm Katie. I write La Jolla Mom. La Jolla Mom shares the best tips for San Diego vacation planning, luxury hotel perks, travel worldwide, theme park ticket discounts, & much more. I recap our trips and favorite places around the globe. I also talk about our favorite airlines, airport lounges, and gear. My information will help you plan and spend less on traveling.

feeds.title: Lipgloss and Crayons
feeds.description: I'm Carly and at Lipgloss and Crayons, we are a community that wants to remind you that you are beautiful just as you are. We believe that empowered women raise empowered children. From flattering bathing suits to ways to improve your self-image to all-important self-care tips you will find everything. We are here to encourage women.

feeds.title: Someday I'll Learn
feeds.description: I'm Chelsea married to my husband, Nate. Nate offers up hands-on fatherhood and a forthright approach to life's challenges. Chelsea adds color with creative how-tos and commentary about rugged living in a modern era. The blog culminates in a he-said-she-said humorous journal that documents our daily exploits.

feeds.title: Don't Mess with Mama
feeds.description: I'm Tracey Black, founder, and CEO of Don't Mess with Mama. I have a background in health care, publishing, research, nutrition, and wellness. DontMesswithMama.com is an online resource for moms and families who want to take a step towards natural wellness. You'll find gluten-free recipes, authentic food recipes, natural remedies, DIY tutorials, and tips to help you live a more natural lifestyle.

feeds.title: Hewes Family Fun
feeds.description: Hey all, I'm Abby Keen Hewes, a blogger. The reason I started this blog as I got tired of the coupon blogging rat race and decided to initiate a blog to help people with a frugal lifestyle. Hewes Family Fun is the place where you will find posts about fun, family adventures, shopping, research, and more.

feeds.title: Chrissy Powers Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Chrissy, a therapist, coach, and eternal optimist. I empower others to step into their passion. Here I write about relationships, motherhood, home, style, and life. My motive is to encourage others to live their fullest life through unfreezing patterns of trauma, fear, and shame.

feeds.title: The Sunny Side Up Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Erin, welcome to Sunny Side Up where I share my obsession with organization, home decor, and fashion. I started this journal as a way to stay connected and share pictures with family and friends soon turned into a lifestyle blog about all of my passions. Sunny Side Up is full of ideas on how to organize every single space in your house along with lots of time management tips.

feeds.title: enjoy it
feeds.description: enJOY it is a craft and lifestyle blog from Elise Blaha Cripe. On this blog page, you can read her small business stories or start with some of her favorite things to write about, DIY home decor & goal-setting. You can also listen to her motivational speech about the power of making bold statements.

feeds.title: Natalie Borton Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Natalie and I'm an entrepreneur. My goal with this blog is to make your life easier, specifically when it comes to personal style. I believe that what we look like is the least interesting thing about us. I'm constantly pursuing more authenticity and intentionality in my life and choices, and I love to share about that, as well as promote body neutrality and self-acceptance overall.

feeds.title: FamDiego Blog
feeds.description: Family tips for exploring all of San Diego with your kids! FamDiego shares the best kid-friendly museums & restaurants, to indoor & outdoor play areas and of course the best beaches and everything else in between!

feeds.title: San Diego Momma Blog
feeds.description: I'm an ad copywriter who is working on completing a middle-grade supernatural thriller. Sharing some humor, a bit of writing, and way too much information

feeds.title: Brilliant Business Moms
feeds.description: At Brilliant Business Moms, we're for the mom bloggers, the retailers, the designers, the photographers, and the DIYers. This is a place where you can find not only resources and information to help you grow your business but also community and support. We've created a community of motivated, smart, and encouraging women who are committed to making small wins.

feeds.title: SoCal Savvy Mom
feeds.description: Welcome to SoCal Savvy Mom, a parenting and lifestyle Blog, here we share our tips for enjoying and or surviving Disneyland adventures. SoCal Savvy Mom is a home shopping network to find out the newest baby and kid items. We also feature fun activities and events to do with your children. SoCal Savvy Mom is about how we can help you enjoy more time with your family doing fun things.

feeds.title: City Girl Gone Mom
feeds.description: The author of CityGirlGoneMom Danielle Schaffer has a passion for broadcasting and a knack for home design. Danielle guides moms through discovering new and tried-and-true family experiences. CityGirlGoneMom seeks to entertain, educate and inspire those who could use a good laugh, a few parenting tips, and some positive momentum.
